thread.title: These Dow stocks were clobbered in February — but there were winners too

author: Philip van Doorn
title: These Dow stocks were clobbered in February — but there were winners too
text:
U.S. stock indexes fell in February for the first time in almost a year, ending on a sour note Wednesday as some of the largest companies suffered big declines.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.50% fell nearly 400 points, or 1.5% Wednesday, bringing February’s drop to 4.3%. The S&P 500 Index SPX, -1.11% receded 1.1%, making for a 3.9% monthly decrease. The last monthly drop in either index was March 2017.
Wednesday’s action reflected investors’ fear of rising inflation and interest rates, and comments from Federal Reserve Chairman Jerome Powell indicate the Federal Open Market Committee may react in a hawkish manner to an acceleration in economic growth resulting from the tax legislation that President Trump signed in December.

WMT, -1.65% was the worst performer in February on concern online sales growth will continue to slow . Still, the company is launching four private-label clothing brands to compete with rivals Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +0.03% and Target Corp. TGT, -0.21% 
Cisco Systems Inc. CSCO, -0.58% was the best Dow performer of the month. Jeff Reeves included the company in his list of three tech stocks to buy .
